description: Documents the specific error scenario of API-057 (Create Payment) where amountPaid is zero. Same endpoint as API-057, isolated here to preserve the original docs/API_Contracts_and_Test_Results.xlsx functionality numbering. This is a confirmed DB GAP.

body.amountPaid: 0.00 - the failing value in this scenario

validation: amountPaid should be > 0 per the intended API contract

success.status_definition: N/A - this functionality ID documents only the failure path; see API-057 for the success contract

notes: database/schema/026_payment.sql defines amount_paid NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount_paid >= 0) - this CHECK permits exactly 0, so database/api_contracts_test/015_payment.sql's API-T122 scenario (amountPaid = 0.00) is currently ACCEPTED by PostgreSQL ('INSERT 0 1 — amount 0.00 accepted'), even though the intended API behavior is 400 Bad Request. The database constraint would need to change to CHECK (amount_paid > 0) to actually enforce this at the DB layer; until then, rejection of a zero amount must happen at the API layer only.
